text:
Maria: Quick poll — 12:15 today for a 15-min core sesh in Huddle A? Also doing a tiny climbing-gear swap after lunch. I have a near-new Scarpa Vapor V (9.5). :shoe:
Devin: I'm in for core. Bodyweight-only ok? Floors look sketchy. Also interested in the shoes — 9.5 here.
Samir: Count me out for core (blocking meeting), but yes to the shoe swap. I've got LaSportiva Solutions size 10 — available to trade/loan.
Olivia: I'll join — bringing a mat. Quick Q: is there a chalk bucket refill? mine's empty :grimacing: 
Ben: FitBot says there's chalk in cupboard C under the stairs. If it's low I can bring a small pump.
FitBot: Reminder: 15-min core session starts at 12:15 in Huddle A. Reactions so far: :thumbsup: 3 :raised_hands: 1
Maria: Ben can you grab the chalk? I'll bring a spare pump for the wall ropes. Shoe trade plan: Samir size 10, Devin 9.5 — maybe short borrow at the mini-wall after lunch.
Devin: Still good — if nobody else wants the 9.5 Scarpa I'll take it for a week trial. Meet 1pm at the office mini-wall for a quick test.
Olivia: I put together a 6-exercise circuit we can run — quick and brutal: planks, hollow holds, bird dogs, glute bridges, side planks, mountain climbers. 45s on / 15s off.
Maria: Paste it here? I'll add to the calendar invite.
Olivia: Here:
```
45s plank
15s rest
45s hollow hold
15s rest
45s bird dog (alternating)
15s rest
45s glute bridge
15s rest
45s side plank each side (split)
15s rest
45s mountain climbers
15s rest
repeat once
```
Samir: :muscle: Nice. Pro-tip: planks on the padded bench save wrists.
Ben: Heads-up I might be +5-10 — meeting may spill to 12:20. If someone warms up, go ahead and grab a mat for me.
Maria: No stress — we'll start and run a mini-second round when Ben arrives.
Devin: Challenge idea: whoever finishes both rounds gets a sticker on the whiteboard. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
FitBot: Event created: "12:15 Core + Shoe Swap" — https://calendar.example/ev/1883456789
Ben: See you all in Huddle A. Devin/Samir DM to coordinate the Scarpa handoff.
